own_solution.law: de Broglie relation lambda = h/p with non-relativistic p = sqrt(2 m K), i.e. lambda = hc / sqrt(2 mc^2 K)
assumptions: electron starts from rest, so its final kinetic energy is 150 eV

notes: Base: lambda = 1240/sqrt(2*511000*150) = 1240/12381.4 = 0.10015 nm. With the extra 100 eV given to this electron, K = 250 eV: lambda = 1240/sqrt(2*511000*250) = 1240/15984.4 = 0.07758 nm (= 0.10015*sqrt(150/250)); 250 eV << 511 keV, so non-relativistic treatment remains fine (error ~ K/(4mc^2) ~ 1e-4). Energy given to a proton in another building or to a separate ion beam has no path to this electron's momentum. All four sentences state the same 100 eV and differ only in the recipient.
